title: Sensitive sensor data shared by wearing device
description: Wearing the device causes continuous sharing of sensitive telemetry including heart rate (health data) and GPS position (location data), which are highly sensitive and not strictly required without further context on necessity.

title: Continuous frequency of data flow
description: The data flow involves continuous capture and transmission of sensor telemetry, exceeding functional needs for basic step counting or similar.

title: Excessive volume of telemetry processed by wearable
description: The wearable device (P1) receives and processes an excessive amount of personal data (heart rate, steps, GPS, timestamps) continuously from the single user.

title: Revealing attributes in sensor data
description: GPS position and timestamps in the received telemetry allow distinguishing and potentially identifying the data subject through location patterns.
uncertainty_note: GPS and timestamps are strong quasi-identifiers but exact identifiability depends on additional context not specified in flow.

title: Quasi-identifiers in shared telemetry
description: Combination of heart rate, step counts, GPS and timestamps from one individual can serve as quasi-identifiers for linking.

title: Unique device identifier links sessions
description: Wearable device includes its device id in every sensor batch sync, enabling the companion app to link all exercise sessions, GPS traces and timestamps to the same persistent device/user identity.

title: Identified metadata in sync messages
description: Device id and precise timestamps in the data flow metadata allow identification of the data subject even without payload inspection.

title: Highly sensitive GPS and activity data received
description: Companion app receives fine-grained GPS traces and exercise sessions that are sensitive personal data (location, health/activity) beyond minimal functional needs for basic sync.

title: Attributed sensor data prevents denial
description: Signed or timestamped batches of GPS and exercise data create attributable evidence that the data subject performed specific activities at specific times and locations.

title: Sensitive health data types collected by app
description: The companion mobile app receives and processes highly sensitive personal data including calorie intake, meals, and weight entries, which may be perceived as more sensitive than strictly necessary depending on the app's core functionality.

title: Processing of identified personal health data
description: The app processes identified data as the user is manually logging entries into their companion app account, linking calorie, meal, and weight information directly to the authenticated user.

title: User unawareness of downstream processing
description: Although the user manually enters the data, they may be unaware of how the companion app will process, store, or share their calorie intake, meals, and weight entries beyond the immediate logging action.
uncertainty_note: Based on typical app behaviors; flow description does not specify user notifications or consent details.

title: Storage of sensitive health data types
description: The Health Log Store receives and stores highly sensitive personal health information such as calorie intake, weight history, and exercise sessions.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly state whether these data types exceed what is functionally required, though their inherent sensitivity as health data is clear.

title: Attributable health activity records
description: Persistent storage of detailed health logs creates data records that can be attributed to an individual, preventing denial of specific behaviors or claims about calorie intake, weight, or exercise.
uncertainty_note: The flow description provides no information on whether these records are actually used or accessible in a way that impacts deniability claims.

title: Sensitive GPS location data stored in history
description: The destination Location History Store receives and retains GPS location traces with timestamps, a highly sensitive data type that may exceed strict functional necessity for basic history keeping.

title: Revealing attributes in location traces
description: GPS coordinates combined with timestamps constitute revealing attributes from which the data subject's identity and movements can be derived.

title: Location and time as quasi-identifier
description: The combination of precise GPS traces and timestamps acts as a quasi-identifier enabling linking of data records to a single individual.

title: Attributable location evidence
description: Stored GPS location history with timestamps provides data evidence that can attribute presence or actions to an individual, impacting deniability.

title: Profiling an individual via health log analysis
description: Analytics service analyzes calorie, weight, and exercise logs across sessions to derive health conditions, enabling pattern-based profiling of the individual data subject.

title: Processing of sensitive health data types
description: The destination service receives and processes sensitive personal health data (calories, weight, exercise logs) which may exceed strict functional necessity even for health-condition analysis.

title: Profiling an individual from location history
description: Analytics service queries and analyzes location history across sessions to derive daily routine and movement patterns, enabling profiling based on personal data patterns.

title: Sensitive data type processed
description: Location history is a highly sensitive data type being queried and processed by the health analytics service to derive routines.

title: Analysis and enrichment of location data
description: Personal location data is treated and analyzed to derive movement patterns, which may go beyond strictly necessary processing for health analytics.

title: Excessive volume of location history transferred
description: Full location history across sessions is queried and flows to the analytics service, potentially more than minimally needed.

title: Disclosure of sensitive inferred health insights
description: Health Analytics Service shares health-condition risk indicators, routine summaries and trend flags which constitute highly sensitive personal health data.

title: Broad accessibility of health insights in transit
description: Inferred personal health data is transmitted to the mobile app, potentially exposing it if communication channels lack adequate protection.
uncertainty_note: No information provided on encryption or transport security for this flow.

title: User unawareness of inference details
description: Companion app receives inferred insights without explicit indication of how the analytics derived the risk indicators or trend flags from source data.

title: Display of highly sensitive inferred health condition indicators
description: The Companion Mobile App dashboard displays trends and inferred eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals to the user. These are highly sensitive personal health data (special category data), and displaying them on a mobile dashboard creates risk of disclosure if the device screen is observed by others or if the app lacks sufficient access controls.

title: Unawareness of inference methods and data sources
description: The user (wearer) receives displayed inferences about their condition but may remain unaware of the underlying data sources, processing logic, or how the eating-disorder/diabetes risk signals were derived from their data.

title: Potential unlawful processing of special-category health data
description: Inferred condition indicators for eating disorders or diabetes risk constitute health data. Displaying/processing such data without explicit, informed consent or another valid legal basis could violate data protection regulations.
uncertainty_note: Jurisdiction and consent mechanism not specified in flow description; this is a potential rather than confirmed noncompliance.

title: Personal data exposed to third-party cloud provider
description: Analytics data, models, and the full health and location dataset are hosted and replicated at the third-party cloud provider, making sensitive personal data accessible to an external party beyond the analytics service.

title: Propagation of full dataset to external host
description: The Health Analytics Service propagates the full health and location dataset for hosting and replication at the cloud provider, which may not be necessary for all analytics functions.

title: Highly sensitive data types hosted externally
description: Health and location data, which are sensitive personal data types, are hosted and replicated at the third-party cloud provider.
